hero.title: Radiant Waves Media Morning Global News
hero.description: Tuesday, August 4, 2026. Good morning. Here are today's verified breaking headlines, world news, business, technology and security updates from around the globe.

featured.title: Europe Battles Wildfires As Heatwave Continues
featured.content: Firefighters remain on high alert across Spain, France, Greece and other parts of southern Europe as extreme temperatures, drought and strong winds continue to fuel destructive wildfires. Authorities are urging residents to follow evacuation instructions where necessary.

articles.title: Iran Remains Global Diplomatic Focus
articles.description: World leaders continue diplomatic engagement following renewed warnings involving Iran, with international calls for restraint to avoid wider regional conflict.

articles.title: Deadly Drone Blast Reported In Russia
articles.description: Authorities reported that at least seven people were killed after a drone exploded on a crowded beach. Investigations into the incident are continuing.

articles.title: Migration Pressure Continues In Europe
articles.description: European governments continue discussions on migration policy and humanitarian support following recent developments in Spain's Ceuta enclave.

articles.title: Wildfires Continue Across Southern Europe
articles.description: Emergency services remain deployed across Spain, France and Greece as firefighters battle multiple wildfires fueled by extreme heat and dry conditions.

articles.title: Pakistan Investigates Deadly Bombing
articles.description: Security agencies are investigating a suicide bombing that targeted a public rally, leaving multiple people dead and many others injured.

articles.title: Markets Watch Global Developments
articles.description: Investors continue monitoring geopolitical developments, inflation, oil prices and central bank policy expectations.

articles.title: Heatwave Raises Climate Concerns
articles.description: Long-lasting heatwaves and drought conditions continue affecting parts of Europe, increasing wildfire risks and pressure on emergency services.

articles.title: Commonwealth Games Officially Conclude
articles.description: The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games concluded with a closing ceremony celebrating athletes from across the Commonwealth as preparations begin for the next edition.

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence Investment Continues
articles.description: Technology companies continue expanding investment in artificial intelligence, cloud computing, semiconductor development and cybersecurity.

articles.title: African Economic Cooperation Advances
articles.description: African governments continue strengthening regional trade, infrastructure development and economic partnerships.

articles.title: Global Diplomacy Continues
articles.description: International organizations continue diplomatic engagement on regional security, humanitarian assistance and global cooperation.
